about_the_game:
Welcome, Hacker!
Net.Attack() is a bullet-heaven roguelite where you visually program your own attack algorithms using 190+ drag-and-drop nodes, then watch them execute in real-time combat against security system hordes.

Build devastating attack algorithms using drag-and-drop programming nodes. Chain triggers, branch conditionals, and loop executions to create thousands of unique combinations. Your custom code unleashes bullet-heaven chaos automatically. You focus on strategy and survival while your algorithms execute.

Chain nodes to spawn projectiles that multiply on impact. Let the enemies shoot at each other or loop execution to create sustained area-of-effect devastation.

Break into hostile systems across multiple regions in a near-future cyberwar. Each region presents unique security protocols and escalating difficulty levels.

Face relentless waves of security countermeasures in fast-paced bullet-heaven combat. Your custom-coded algorithms execute automatically based on the logic you engineer, unleashing storms of projectiles while you navigate the chaos. Each run pushes your builds to their breaking point.

Choose from multiple hacker characters, each with unique starting abilities and specializations. Potentially unlock nodes from other sets for even more complex combinations. Find your playstyle and engineer your personal path to dominance.

Collect DarkBits# with each chip extraction and exchange them on the DarkMarket for new operatives and permanent power upgrades across runs. Uncover additional regions as you progress and gather bonus currency by completing missions like the Daily Challenge.
